data.source_title: Reduced isolation room turnover time using Lean methodology
data.locator: Abstract, Design/Setting/Results; room turnover endpoint defined from discharged patient exit to UV disinfection completion.
data.source_setting: Quaternary academic pediatric referral facility, Cincinnati Children's Hospital Medical Center; transmission-based precaution isolation rooms.
data.source_period: 60-day quality-improvement before/after project; published 2019. Exact calendar dates and observation counts are not stated in the accessible abstract.
data.source_n: Manual time-study sample size not stated in the accessible abstract; before/after observations were performed.
data.quantity: Median isolation-room turnover to UV disinfection completion, before vs after
data.source_evidence_basis: The original study reports measured manual time-study medians and ranges. Turnover includes breakdown, cleaning, and waiting through completion of UV disinfection, not just surface-cleaning labor.
data.limitations: Pediatric isolation-room workflow with UV disinfection; before/after improvement project, sample counts unavailable in abstract, and the median/range are not a fitted distribution. Not a generic adult bed-cleaning time or RWJ fact.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Model cleaning/turnaround as a gated room-readiness transition with separate cleaning and post-clean disinfection steps where locally applicable. Use the observed result only as an external isolation-room benchmark, not a standard bed-turnaround parameter.

data.source_title: Reduced isolation room turnover time using Lean methodology
data.locator: Abstract, Results; duration of room cleaning and curtain changing.
data.source_setting: Quaternary academic pediatric referral facility; isolation-room cleaning and curtain changing.
data.source_period: 60-day quality-improvement before/after project; exact dates not stated in accessible abstract.
data.source_n: Manual time-study sample size not stated in accessible abstract.
data.quantity: Median active room-cleaning and curtain-changing duration, before vs after
data.source_evidence_basis: The study reports measured median duration for the room-cleaning and curtain-changing task, separate from total room turnover. It also reports median wait from cleaning complete to UV start of 36 minutes before and 8 minutes after (Abstract, Results).
data.limitations: Isolation-room pediatric task with curtain replacement; intervention-specific and not an adult routine clean. Accessible abstract gives no sample count or distribution; no inference to other facilities.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Keep active EVS task duration separate from queue/wait for cleaning start and any required post-clean disinfection. Treat observed medians as scenario references only; do not sum medians as a patient-level total or assign a distribution.
